name: Courage

definition_by_age.4: Being brave even when a little scared.
definition_by_age.6: Courage means trying something new even when it feels a little scary.
definition_by_age.8: Courage is facing fear or difficulty with trust in Allah and taking the right action anyway.

learning_objective: Children can describe trying something new even though it felt scary.

recommended_default.note: Reassigned 2026-08-05 during pattern-diversity fix (was pattern_003). FIX: pattern_007 (Fear->Small Brave Step->Support->Confidence) was built specifically for courage — recommended_default was stale, still pointing to pattern_003 from before pattern_007 existed.

qv_013.reasoning: The Prophet's real words to Abu Bakr in the cave — directly about courage amid fear.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Storm fear fits the same fear->step->support->confidence shape as the primary, just a different trigger.
